steps.text:
You can filter **K8SPod** records on any of the fields listed in its model:

| Field (path) | Type |
|--------------|------|
| `key` | string (primary key) |
| `name` | string |
| `namespace` | string |
| `ready.count` | int |
| `ready.outof` | int |
| `status` | string |
| `restarts.count` | int |
| `restarts.ago` | string |
| `age` | string |
| `ip` | string |
| `node` | string |
| `clusterName` | string |

You can use any of these fields in a `where` clause of an L8Query to filter pods (e.g., `where status='Running'` or `where restarts.count>5`).
